data.body: Gerrit 1876 advisory remediation: the final held-out oracle now separates the two contractual properties instead of carrying a redundant aggregate_elapsed parametrization. test_outer_deadline_leaves_cleanup_headroom asserts the nested subprocess receives at least 30 seconds; test_completed_watchdog_result_is_not_rejected_by_aggregate_runtime simulates a completed result after 13 aggregate seconds and asserts it is returned rather than rejected. Per the test-modification guard, I first restored the exact original 12-second outer deadline plus post-hoc elapsed<10 rejection: the final-form oracle was RED 2/2 for the two distinct mechanisms (12 >= 30 failed; 13.00s post-hoc rejection failed). Restoring the fix returned GREEN: held-out plus repo-isolation guard 14 passed. Formatting, make lint, mypy typecheck, and diff-check pass.
